description: Returns every US symbol that was trading on as_of, including companies that later delisted (survivorship-free). index='top500'|'top1000'|'top3000' instead returns the most-traded names priced at least $5 that day, ranked by 63-day dollar volume (a point-in-time large-cap proxy, not official S&P or Russell membership). Pages of 500; pass offset. as_of defaults to today.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).
